images.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit Image 1, the supplied 1254×1254 canvas. Deliver ONE same-size 2×2 sprite sheet, four 627×627 cells, no borders, labels or gutters, pure flat #00ff00 background. Preserve the entire top-left cell SLOT 0 PIXEL-IDENTICAL, including its existing approved rest-frame character and green pixels. Fill only the three empty green cells: top-right = idle frame 4, bottom-left = idle frame 5, bottom-right = idle frame 6. Copy the exact character from slot 0 into those cells at identical cell-relative position, size and baseline, with only the specified minute breathing changes. Character is a young woman with dark curly hair tied back, ivory rolled-sleeve shirt, navy sleeveless tabard with plain chest, one diagonal chestnut harness to an olive canvas satchel on her anatomical LEFT hip, one belt, laced bracers, navy trousers, chestnut boots, plain walnut staff with brass ferrules upright in anatomical RIGHT hand. No insignia anywhere. Direction S facing camera; same elevated three-quarter projection C camera in every cell. Never mirror, zoom, or matte. H=470 px in each cell. Relaxed breathing loop: 16 frames, 2 seconds at 8 fps, one breath. Frame 4 peak inhale, frame 8 rest, frame 12 bottom exhale, frame 16 rest. Relative to slot 0: frame 4 chest/shoulder total width +7.7 px, head image-down +1.4 px; frame 5 chest/shoulder width +7.1 px, head image-down +1.3 px; frame 6 chest/shoulder width +5.4 px, head image-down +1.0 px. ONLY shoulders, chest and head move: inhaling shoulders lift and chest broadens, head rides gently by at most 2 px. Preserve head size, facial drawing, eyes and fixed gaze. LOCK PIXEL-FOR-PIXEL to rest in cell-relative coordinates: hips, legs, feet and soles, both arms and hands, staff grip and tip, satchel and belt. Subtle coherent progression from peak inhale toward rest; no pose redesign. HAND-DRAWN painted 2D animation frame: confident hand-drawn dark contour with visible taper and varying weight, painted fills in clean planes inside line, restrained texture, readable silhouette, no conspicuous grain. Match the supplied drawing exactly. Single cold key from SCREEN UPPER-LEFT fixed in every cell; deep cool low-value ambient with readable nonblack shadows, slight rim on key-facing silhouette; no warm spell illumination and NO floor shadows. Blue, ivory and brass Keeper palette. Preserve SLOT 0 exactly; change only the empty cells.
RETRY CORRECTION: the previous attempt incorrectly enlarged and redrew the protected top-left character. Work from the ORIGINAL supplied seed again. This is a localized canvas fill, not a new composition. Top-left rectangle x=0..626, y=0..626 MUST remain untouched pixel-for-pixel. The original character bounds are approximately x=223..403, y=94..564, including staff. Keep those original bounds in slot 0. Each added character must occupy precisely the translated bounds: slot 1 x=850..1030,y=94..564; slot 2 x=223..403,y=721..1191; slot 3 x=850..1030,y=721..1191, with only the tiny specified torso and head offsets. Thus every character is 470 pixels tall with generous green margins, never stretched to fill the cell. Retain the original reference face, narrow silhouette, original staff, boots and every locked detail. Keep all empty background exactly pure #00ff00 without texture, gradient or shadow. Do not touch slot 0.
